title: Eye DPI drift: snap timing fix
desc: AnimateMoveTo snap must wait 150ms after animation for WM_DPICHANGED to settle. Never remove snap -- it corrects WPF mixed-DPI positioning.
steps: ROOT CAUSE: anim2.Completed snap reads GetDpiForWindow too early -- Eye still on 96 DPI monitor before crossing boundary, snap places at wrong physical coords.
WRONG FIX: removing snap entirely. Snap is required for WPF per-monitor DPI correction (Window.Left is logical, SetWindowPos needs physical). Without snap Eye lands wrong on mixed-DPI setups.

CORRECT FIX (AppBotEyeWindow.cs AnimateMoveTo): anim2.Completed += async (_, _) => { await Task.Delay(150); dpi=GetDpiForWindow(Eye); physX=x*(dpi/96); SetWindowPos(physX, physY); }. 150ms lets WM_DPICHANGED settle after monitor boundary crossing.
author: claude
